title: sphaerostephanos cataractorum
intro: Sphaerostephanos cataractorum, commonly known as the Cat's Claw Fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The health benefits of Sphaerostephanos cataractorum include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and support immune system function.
